tollsAndPermits: Gurgaon feeding straight onto NH48 (Jaipur–Udaipur–Vadodara–Surat–Mumbai) makes this the cleanest Delhi-NCR origin for the corridor. Haryana/Rajasthan/Gujarat/Maharashtra check-post entries, the toll chain and Mumbai entry tolls are itemised in the quote; the GST e-way bill is raised before dispatch.

faqs.q: How long does a Gurgaon to Mumbai move take?
faqs.a: Dedicated trucks deliver in 3–4 days door to door. Loading in Gurgaon's high-rise societies happens in the booked service-lift slot, usually a morning; delivery into Mumbai respects the society's permitted move hours — both are fixed in your written schedule.

faqs.q: Is a Gurgaon loading different from a Delhi loading?
faqs.a: Operationally, smoother: Gurgaon does not have Delhi's city-wide peak no-entry windows, but societies strictly enforce gate passes and lift slots. The truck reaches NH48 quickly, which is why Gurgaon-origin corridor moves usually leave on schedule.

faqs.q: What does moving a 2 BHK from Gurgaon to Mumbai cost?
faqs.a: It depends on your inventory, floors, lift access, packing level and distance. We run a free survey (video or doorstep) and then confirm an itemised written quote — no advance is needed to book.

faqs.q: Can my car go with the same move?
faqs.a: Cars travel on dedicated car carriers with their own condition reports; bikes go crated with the household consignment. Clubbing them on one booking avoids duplicate logistics fees — priced as distinct lines.

faqs.q: How is delivery handled in Mumbai's older buildings?
faqs.a: If your destination is a walk-up or small-lift building, the survey at the Mumbai end determines stair-carry crew size or an external furniture lift where permitted. That plan — and its cost — is written into the quote before pickup in Gurgaon.
